prompt: Can a self-employed individual with gross sales below ₱3 million opt for the 8% income tax rate?
answer:
### Short Answer
Yes, a self-employed individual with gross sales below ₱3 million can opt for the 8% income tax rate, provided their gross sales or gross receipts do not exceed the VAT threshold of ₱3 million.

### Controlling Authorities
The relevant provision is found in Section 24(B)(1)(b) of the National Internal Revenue Code (NIRC), which allows self-employed individuals and professionals to choose an 8% tax on gross sales or receipts exceeding ₱250,000 in lieu of the graduated income tax rates.

### Interpretation
Under the NIRC, self-employed individuals whose gross sales or receipts do not exceed the VAT threshold (₱3 million) can avail themselves of the 8% income tax rate. This option is available as long as their gross income exceeds ₱250,000, which is the minimum threshold for taxation under this scheme.

### Practical Meaning
This provision provides a simplified tax option for small businesses and self-employed individuals, allowing them to pay a flat rate of 8% on their income above ₱250,000 instead of following the more complex graduated income tax rates. This can lead to easier compliance and potentially lower tax liabilities for those with lower gross sales.
